morphology.pattern_note: 输入中的 dal 词根分析须纠正：medal 是整体借入的英语词，不是 me- + dal。é 表示 /e/，不是 /ə/。以下词族项目是复合词组，并非加缀派生词。[DBP：medal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=medal)

senses.zh_definition: 作为竞赛成绩、功绩或服务表现的表彰而颁发的金属奖牌或勋章。
senses.en_definition: A metal award presented for achievement, merit, or service; a medal or decoration.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录的标准名词，意义同时涵盖竞赛奖牌和表彰功绩的勋章。马来西亚正式报道及颁奖表述通常更常使用 pingat；medal 不是由马来语动词前缀 me- 构成。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Atlet negara itu memenangi medal emas dalam acara renang tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该国家队运动员在那项游泳比赛中赢得金牌。
dual_scenarios.en: The national athlete won a gold medal in that swimming event.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Adik kau dah menang medal emas ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah adik kamu sudah memenangi medal emas?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你弟弟已经拿到金牌啦？
dual_scenarios.en: Has your younger brother won a gold medal?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式
口语中 menang 可直接搭配 medal，正式表达通常用 memenangi

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Adik kau dah menang medal emas kat kejohanan tu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah adik kamu sudah memenangi medal emas dalam kejohanan itu?
messages.zh: 你弟弟在那个锦标赛拿到金牌啦？
messages.en: Did your younger brother win a gold medal at that championship?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, acara renang. Dia nak tunjuk medal tu kat mak malam ni.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dalam acara renang. Dia hendak menunjukkan medal itu kepada ibu malam ini.
messages.zh: 对啊，游泳项目。他今晚要拿给妈妈看。
messages.en: Yeah, in swimming. He wants to show Mum the medal tonight.

etymology.historical_story: DBP explicitly identifies English as the source language of Malay medal. The borrowing names a physical token of public recognition, whether earned in competition or awarded for service. Its initial letters happen to resemble a Malay prefix, but the dictionary treats medal as a noun, not as a verb built from dal. [DBP: medal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=medal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 medal，就想英语 medal 和领奖台上的奖牌；整词一起记，别拆成 me- 与 dal。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 祝贺获奖者时可说 Tahniah atas kejayaan memenangi pingat emas。涉及国家或王室荣誉时，应采用该荣誉完整、准确的正式名称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于体育、学术竞赛及功绩表彰。正式马来西亚文稿通常优先选 pingat；不要混同 medal、piala（奖杯）与 sijil（证书）。
